_comment: Chat console texts. {player} is the user's display name (default Nurasik). Placeholders in braces are substituted at runtime.

help.footer: Tip: press Tab to complete a command.

commands.name: advancement
commands.description: Opens the advancements screen, lists progress, or resets everything (/advancement reset confirm).

commands.name: brew
commands.description: Starts a brew (focus timer), e.g. 25m, 1h30m, or stops the running one.

commands.name: gamemode
commands.description: Sets your game mode: normal, everything on, performance, or focus.

commands.name: give
commands.description: Gives you an app: launches it into your inventory.

commands.name: help
commands.description: Shows help pages or the usage of a command.

commands.name: locate
commands.description: Finds where an app is running and takes you there.

commands.name: reload
commands.description: Reloads the shell, config and quotes.

commands.name: seed
commands.description: Shows the seed of the current wallpaper world.

commands.name: time
commands.description: Switches Day/Night mode, follows the sun, or tells the time.

commands.name: title
commands.description: Sets the title shown when you enter a workspace.

commands.name: weather
commands.description: Overrides the weather overlay, or follows the real forecast.

tips: Press SUPER+F3 to see the debug screen
Press SUPER+F4 to open the game mode switcher
Press SUPER+Slash to start a chat command
Press SUPER+Space to open the creative inventory
Press SUPER+Return to open a terminal
Press SUPER+Q to mine the window you are looking at
Press SUPER+N to open the multiplayer server list
Press SUPER+W to pick a world for your wallpaper
Press SUPER+B to start a brew
Press SUPER+I to read your chat history of notifications
Press SUPER+SHIFT+I to switch the difficulty to Peaceful
Press SUPER+T to flip between Day and Night
Scroll over the hotbar to cycle your workspaces
Use /tp 5 to jump straight to workspace 5
Use /title 3 Library to rename a workspace
Use /locate kitty to find your terminal
Use /give kitty to open an app from chat
Use /time set auto to let the sun pick Day or Night
Use /weather rain for a cozy coding session
Use /gamemode spectator to hide the bar and focus
Use /brew 25m to start a 25-minute focus brew
Hover over an inventory slot to see the app's tooltip
Mining a window shows crack stages before it closes
Your battery is hearts; below 20 % they start to jiggle
Your memory is hunger; keep it filled
Your uptime is XP: one level each hour
Finish brews to fill the bottles in the brewing stand
Notifications arrive as toasts; urgent ones are challenges
Create New World renders a fresh wallpaper from a seed
Adventure mode turns off animations for performance
Creative mode silences hunger and heart warnings
Peaceful difficulty is Do Not Disturb
Advancements are unlocked by counting events, never keystrokes
Type /help to list every command
Press Tab to complete a chat command
Press Up in the chat to repeat an old command
Right-click is not required, but the tooltip is nice
You can resize the GUI scale in Options
Dark mode is Night, light mode is Day
Take a screenshot with Print; it lands in your chat
Hold the pickaxe: a closed window is a mined block
Don't dig straight down. Save your files first
